producer_artifact_bridge_consumer.contract: When a configured ordinary NL launch requests a provider preflight, settlement is required and bound to the server-created run, tenant, cell, effective profile, control job, and nl-run budget key. Only an exact, current producer event reference matching configured request/model/provider and cache scope can support the successful report. reported, estimated, reuse, unknown, and terminal settlement states remain distinct.
producer_artifact_bridge_consumer.producer: run_provider_preflight in provider_verification.py calls a configured HTTP provider path; the test producer uses a real localhost HTTP server and response payloads, not a returned report stub. Response-declared model/provider labels are not treated as authority for configured identity.
producer_artifact_bridge_consumer.artifact_and_event: The preflight report carries a producer event reference. The loopback positive writes LLMProducerEvent producer_settlements to FileBudgetLedger; the report/reference digest is recomputed and compared to the stored event. A reuse event is distinct from its origin event and has amount zero. The launch refusal path writes a runtime.provider_preflight_report artifact and embeds its reference and payload into a failed control-job progress record.
producer_artifact_bridge_consumer.bridge: ControlPlaneService ordinary POST /api/v1/control/runs/nl computes execution scope and server IDs, binds the selected app-scoped producer settlement store, requires settlement, and treats every non-ok report (including skipped) as a launch refusal before NL pipeline enqueue.
producer_artifact_bridge_consumer.consumer: Tests reopen FileBudgetLedger and resolve selected run records; the secure POST test fetches GET /api/v1/control/jobs/{job_id} while TestClient lifespan is active and compares the persisted report reference, full payload, failed state and provider_preflight phase.
